subject: gk
question: State public services; State Public Service Commission comes under which list of seventh schedule of the Indian constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is **State list**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points:__**

__Some important subjects under all three lists are:__

 
 

 Union list
 State list
 Concurrent list
 
 

 
 
 
• Defence
 
• Foreign affairs
 
• Election Commission
 
• Finance Commission
 
• Security
 
• Railways
 
• Banking
 
• Central Forces
 
 
 
 
 
• Police
 
• Public order
 
• Panchayat
 
• State Election commission
 
• Agriculture
 
• Irrigation
 
• Toll tax
 
• Health
 
 
 
 
 
• Education
 
• Marriage
 
• Newspaper
 
• Protection of wildlife.
 
• Employment
 
 
 
 

__
 
• There are 100 subjects that come under the Union list.
 
• There are 61 subjects that come under the State list.
 
• There are 52 subjects that come under the Concurrent List.
 
• Division of Powers comes under Seventh Schedule.
 
• Residuary list: The subject which does not come under union, state, a concurrent list that will come under residuary list.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

 
• The power to control the residuary list comes in the hand of parliament.
 
• Earlier there were 97, 66, and 47 subjects in Union, State, Concurrent list respectively.
